content:
Preliminary Agenda

PE-1185: “Feature Requests from Teams”

We have a Slack workflow for this, but should we implement it in the #devops channel? How do we move this forward? Decisions needed.

We’ll ask the teams

DORA Metrics: Power BI Report

  • Fix broken link, or “Report not found” issue

  • Internal recap of duplication/copy report routine

    • We should all know exactly how to do this in case of outside questions

  • Loading the report in Power BI desktop

    • Entry point address to the report

    • Basic editing

  • Discussions about the documentation entry point

    • DORA Power BI Report

      • Is it finished, clear enough?

  • How does versioning work - how does our versioning scheme look like?

    • Task created

DORA Metrics: Deprecation of “RequirementDeployed” Event

  • Impact analysis

    • Versioning (GitHub Action, Databricks, Power BI)

  • Timeframe and prioritization

  • Perhaps some experimentation

IPEX DevOps Survey - Questions

I know how, and where, to reach out to the IPEX DevOps Team:

  • Yes

  • No

I know what types of questions I can ask the DevOps Team:

  • Yes, for sure

  • I think so

  • No

I understand what IPEX DevOps is all about - the mindset, principles, and goals:

  • Yes, for sure

  • I believe so, to some extent

  • No

To what extent do you believe the IPEX DevOps team has contributed to more shared collaboration across teams and promotion of shared and reusable technologies?

  • I can't see how this relates to team collaboration or reusable technologies

  • Perhaps to some extent

  • Quite much

  • Don’t know/no opinion

In my team we appreciate the value of CI/CD and are continuously trying to improve e.g., deployment frequency to production environments:

  • What is CI/CD?

  • No, CI/CD is nothing for us really

  • Yes, we adopt CI/CD and may try to improve it in the future

  • Yes, we continuously try to improve our CI/CD process and deployment frequency on a weekly basis

After embracing and adopting DevOps principles I think we are working better now in our team compared to before:

  • Yes

  • No

    • If not, explain why

  • N/A: we are not adopting or adhering to any of the DevOps principles

Describe something you'd like to know more about, or something you feel is missing, in order for you to be able to work better in your team, or across teams:

[FreeTextField]

Azure Function/SSO from VS Code

Someone (Marcus or Joakim) show Tobias a little bit more about deploying our function from within VS code, so that we can plan and design for GitHub workflows and the automation tasks we have on our board.

Outcomes and Notes

  • We’ll ask in the public DevOps channel about feedback regarding pe-1185. We’d like to close the task and move on. Multi-choice answers can become bloated, and we don’t really know how to make use of it. Shorter workflows could be preferable, but what is then the difference compared to asking a general question?

  • Power BI: Some items to update on our documentation page. Steps are summarized in the documentation, but actual usage involves more steps than described. Goal: make it clear to a broad audience on how to do this.

  • DEXF requirement, deprecating ‘RequirementDeployed' discussed - we need to do deeper code impact analysis, to understand the way forward.

    • To be followed up.

  • DevOps survey: Since new questions were recently broadcasted, we should not broadcast immediately again. However, we should conclude our questions. Moving item to next session.

  • Azure Functions and SSO from VS Code: Concluded and demonstrated.
